title: thelypteris cystodioides
intro: Thelypteris cystodioides, commonly known as the cystodioid fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Telypteris cystodioides include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
